# SheetJS Community Edition

`xlsx.mini.min.js` is the unmodified SheetJS CE 0.20.3 mini browser build.

- Copyright (C) 2013-present SheetJS.
- License: Apache License 2.0, supplied in `SheetJS-LICENSE.txt`. The script's copyright header is retained.
- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.mini.min.js
- License source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- Downloaded: 2026-11-26.
- SHA-256: `0cb353f830d7288385492c83d277b058ddeac664ca51cf1393aa1fd3e2b70939`.

Only Excel export loads this local script. The app does not contact the SheetJS CDN or send audit data to SheetJS. The mini build supports the XLSX format used here; CSV export remains implemented in `core.js`.
